headline: 797 dead: Measles outbreak death toll rises in Bangladesh
summary: Four more deaths were reported in just 24 hours as the outbreak continues to cause alarm, particularly in Sylhet.
details: The measles outbreak in Bangladesh has reached a critical point, with the total death toll now standing at 797.
In a worrying trend, four more deaths were reported within a single 24-hour period, signaling a rapid escalation of the virus.
Health officials are particularly concerned about the rising number of fatalities in the Sylhet region, where deaths continue to climb.
The surge in cases is raising significant alarm among health experts and authorities as they struggle to contain the spread of the highly contagious disease.

headline_marked: 3 killed as [[truck crushes auto-rickshaw]] in Mymensingh
headline: 3 killed as truck crushes auto-rickshaw in Mymensingh
summary: Three passengers, including two women, died after a truck crushed their battery-operated auto-rickshaw on the Mymensingh-Kishoreganj highway.
details: A tragic accident on the Mymensingh-Kishoreganj highway left three people dead and one woman injured on Tuesday. The victims include two women and one man who were passengers in a battery-operated auto-rickshaw.

The incident occurred around 1:00 PM in the Shambhuganj area. Local witnesses alleged that the truck was being driven by the driver's assistant rather than the professional driver at the time of the crash.

The deceased have been identified as Shila Akter (25), Abeda Khatun (35), and Debraj Ghosh (35). The injured woman, Tania Sultana (20), was initially taken to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital before being transferred to Dhaka for advanced treatment.
According to witnesses, the truck had just finished unloading goods at a feed depot and was entering the highway when it crushed the auto-rickshaw, leaving the vehicle completely mangled.
The auto-rickshaw driver, Mosharraf Hossain, survived with minor head injuries. Police have seized the truck, but both the driver and the assistant are currently on the run.

Kotwali Model Police Station OC Mohammad Shibbul Islam stated that one man died on the spot, while two women passed away after reaching the hospital. Police are investigating whether the assistant was indeed driving the vehicle.
